block.label: NEW · TOO MUCH, TOO MANY, ENOUGH
block.html:
Too much / too many = more than you want or need. It is a problem!

Countable: There are too many people in the bus.
Uncountable: I put too much salt in the soup. It is terrible!

Enough = the quantity you need. It is OK! It works with countable and uncountable nouns, and it comes before the noun.

We have enough chairs for everybody.
I don't have enough money for a new phone.
Do we have enough eggs for the cake?

block.label: COUNTABLE OR UNCOUNTABLE? (TRICKY WORDS!)
block.html: Some of these words are uncountable in English but countable in Portuguese! Click a word, then the group.

block.label: ATTENTION · NOT LIKE PORTUGUESE
block.html:
These words are uncountable in English. No s, no a / an, and the verb is singular.

✗ I need an advice. → ✓ I need some advice. / I need a piece of advice.
✗ The news are good. → ✓ The news is good.
✗ I have many homeworks. → ✓ I have a lot of homework.
✗ We bought new furnitures. → ✓ We bought new furniture.

Fruit: usually uncountable (I eat a lot of fruit), but you can count types: apples and bananas are fruits that I love.

block.label: READING · NO PLASTIC, PLEASE!
block.html:
Marta lives in Porto Alegre and she has a small shop called Bem Pesado. It is a zero-waste shop: there aren't any plastic bags, and there isn't any packaging. Customers bring their own jars, bags and bottles from home, and they buy exactly the quantity they need.

"In a normal supermarket, you buy a big bag of rice or a packet of pasta, and you often buy too much," Marta says. "Here, you can buy only a little: 200 grams of rice, a few spoonfuls of coffee, or half a dozen eggs."

The shop sells a lot of things: rice, beans, nuts, olive oil, honey, soap and even toothpaste. There aren't many products, but they are all local. "People think it is expensive," she says, "but when you buy only what you need, you don't throw away much food, so you save money."

Not everything is easy. "Some customers forget their jars," Marta laughs. "And on Saturdays there are too many people and there isn't enough space. But I am very happy. Every month, there are more customers and less plastic."

block.html: Then correct the false sentences out loud.

block.label: ROLE-PLAY · THE BIRTHDAY PARTY
block.html: You and a friend are planning a birthday party for 15 people on Saturday. Look at what you have and decide what you need to buy. Use too much, too many, enough, a few, a little and the containers.

roles.name: Ariane
roles.card: At your house, there are: 10 cans of soda, 3 bags of chips, a box of chocolates and 8 chairs. You think there is too much soda. You want a chocolate cake. You have R$ 200 for the party.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.card: At your house, there are: 2 bottles of juice, half a dozen eggs, a little flour, a bunch of bananas and 6 plates. You think there aren't enough chairs. Ask: How many people? How much money do we have? Who is making the cake?
